title: design-extract takes a URL, crawls the live DOM, and reverse-engineers the entire design language

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Design extract takes a URL, crawls the live DOM, and reverse engineers the entire design language. Colors, fonts, grid patterns, hover transitions, responsive breakpoints, outputs a Tailwind config, CSS variables, a shad CN UI theme, and Figma variables. Install the output as a clawed code skill. Type / extractdesignstripe.com and your agent builds a landing page matching that exact design system.
